prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Make ONE horizontal 3:2 polished three-dimensional educational model illustration on a very pale warm-gray background, NO text, NO dimension annotations, NO arrows, no graphs, no logos. Image 1 is a strict GEOMETRY REFERENCE. Re-render only its upper perspective assembly; do not include the bottom drawings, any captions, or additional objects. Exactly two physically identical wooden strips are presented as independent experiments side by side on one simple light worktop: LEFT rests flat, RIGHT is rotated exactly 90 degrees about its long axis and rests on edge. Both strips are 1.00 m long × 0.100 m wide × 0.020 m thick before rotation. Their lengths must stay equal. The left strip is 100 mm wide across its top and 20 mm thick vertically; the right strip is 20 mm across its narrow top and 100 mm tall vertically. Distinct exposed rectangular end faces must demonstrate those two orientations; the vertical board must not become a square stick, must not become taller than 100 mm, and its length must not shrink. Each strip rests on two separate identical support blocks, four total, their actual dimensions 60 mm along the beam ×140 mm across ×100 mm high. Both pairs have exactly 0.80 m between support centers; each wood end projects 0.10 m past its support center. SUPPORT HEIGHT EQUALS the vertical board depth, and is FIVE TIMES the flat board thickness. Preserve all these proportions as in the upper reference. Use the same orthographic camera and world scale for both assemblies, gently elevated view so broad and narrow top faces plus end-grain rectangles remain visible. Fully show both assemblies and all four blocks, no cropping. Honey colored lightly textured wood, muted blue-gray matte blocks, off-white tabletop, soft ambient occlusion and restrained soft shadows. Clean precise physical objects, no glossy toy effect. No hands, people, loads, weights, curved boards, bending, deformations, stress maps or exploded parts. Aim for a calm attractive student-facing scientific model whose only difference is the orientation of the SAME stock.

findings: 两根木条为平放与立放，四块支承分别承托；没有增加荷载、人物、文字或变形。
初版立放木条长边目视较平放木条短约8%–10%，已按同一几何底稿进行一次定向修正。
修正后两根长边在共同视图中的长度更接近，立放截面的窄顶边、宽侧面辨识清楚，支承接触关系可见。
limitations: 图像生成保留的是可见关系，不是CAD约束；单张图不能认证1.00m长度、0.80m支承中心距、0.020m厚度或两木条的精确同体积。
支承与端部悬出长度有视觉近似，不能从图片反推实验测量值；需要精确尺寸时使用随附确定性底稿。
没有施加载荷，不能据图宣称刚度、挠度或承载力比较已经验证。
